PluginData.Author: maxpowa
PluginData.Tooltip: Replaces the vague "Streaming..." loading wheel with a live count of exactly what's loading in — voxels, small grids, static grids, and large grids.
PluginData.Description:
Stop staring at that vague "Streaming..." spinner and wondering what's actually taking so long. This plugin replaces the generic loading wheel with a live, per-category breakdown of exactly what's streaming into your world: how many entities are in flight, and what kind — voxels, small grids, static grids, or large grids. It's lightweight, updates in real time as the stream progresses, and works in any multiplayer session, so the next time the world is loading you'll know precisely what's on its way instead of just waiting blind.
Bugs: https://github.com/maxpowa/SE_WhatAmIStreaming/issues
